decision_summary: Self-review confirms v0.6.28 makes CRD-SUITE-HEALTH structurally satisfiable without treating metadata completeness as semantic validity.
rationale: Visionary: suite validity is now an explicit governed object. Builder: schema, verifier, readiness CLI, examples, and retained fixtures cover all eight dimensions and a positive healthy-suite path. Guardian: example origins, unresolved governance, provisional dimensions, saturation, harness failure, and infrastructure incidents cannot satisfy healthy status; counts and verifier success remain evidence signals only.
recommendation: Proceed to final council review after full npm verification, public-residue scan, and AOF organization verification.
